scene.line: Contract ID: Shadow-041
Destroy a target marked “cargo.”
East District Power Station // Akai gang stronghold
The target is under tight control by the criminal organization “Akai gang.” Find a way through their outer strongholds first.
Paid upon confirmed destruction.
Don't ask what the cargo is. Leave no witnesses.
What the hell?! Did you just come out of the lightning?!
Who the fuck are you? Think you belong here? Get out before I get angry.
Fuck. Looking for trouble, huh.
Fuck!! Get over here!! We're under attack!
Kill him!!
When's this damn rain going to stop? My boots are soaked through.
Quit whining. We'll grab a drink upstairs after this shift.
Wait… Someone's over there.
That thing in the warehouse is scratching the crate again.
Shut up. Pretend you didn't hear it.
It's gone quiet downstairs… Intruder!
Is the Warden still upstairs?
Yeah. No one gets past him.
He's coming up—open fire!
Why are all the alarms downstairs lit up?
Hold the stairs. Don't let him reach the top floor.
Got him! Under the platform!
Isn't the Warden coming down to help?
His orders are to guard the cargo.
Target on the top floor! Crossfire!
Stop. You break into someone's home and start slaughtering people. Don't you think that's rude?
Oh, not much of a talker?
Good. Let's see if you stay silent after I tear off both your legs.
You... you seem to anticipate... my moves
Could you be... I get it. You're here to...
The power station's underground warehouse. The contract target is right under that lamp.
No ID. No warning. Just a damp wooden crate.
Shadow draws his blade. One last strike to finish the job.
—Meow.
The lid slowly springs open. The thing inside is trembling.

barks.line: Kneel now, and you'll still die in one piece.
You think you can just break into Akai gang territory?
One more step and I'll chop you to pieces.
Bounty hunter? You look more like a stray dog.
I was just wondering how to get my kicks tonight.
Don't move! Move again and I'll shoot!
Can you dodge the first shot?
You dare touch the Akai gang's cargo?
This is the end of the road.
